authorization.user_direction: Fix the replacement target as the development candidate and continue autonomously through Lab or Optimization.

source_topology.handoff_rule: docs/OPERATING_DIRECTION.md Source topology discipline, including the user-authorized Optimization-to-Lab handoff required before any Live promotion

allowed_engineering_changes: replace Optimization tester-only identity with a unique Lab engineering identity
remove only the unconditional non-tester OnInit rejection while retaining entries-disabled-by-default and account authorization gates
assign unique Lab release, Portfolio, Magic, state, research-ledger and ownership paths
retain the existing candidate/lifecycle observation contract with component-multiplier-aware attempted-risk recording
materialize fixed selection, forward and entries-disabled configurations
prepare the release-specific operator contract required by a later controlled Live translation
forbidden_changes: change any signal, direction, clock, hold, stop, exit, sizing ladder, component multiplier, risk cap, cost or portfolio ordering term
append to or mutate the current RLO1 canonical research ledgers
adopt current RLO1 state, positions, orders, deals or ownership
use the Master terminal or live-dev runtime
create a validator, parity checker, test harness, CI or test-only infrastructure
promote or enable real entries automatically

logging_contract.old_rlo1_logs: immutable historical evidence; never appended, rotated or cleaned by this family

logging_contract.cross_release_analysis: read-only union only with explicit schema, release, Portfolio and Magic identity

verification_contract.economic_acceptance: exact preserved closed-lifecycle counts and economic results unless an evidenced environment or engineering correction is required
verification_contract.fault_acceptance: zero safety, persistence, broker, foreign-exposure, protection-calculation or protection-mismatch fault
verification_contract.connected_acceptance: bounded entries-disabled create and recovery observation with separate state/log paths before closure
verification_contract.engineering_corrections: unlimited and never classified as an economic failure
